html:
G'oya

Har bir yechish uchun "oxirgi 24 soat" oynasidagi yig'indi kerak. Oyna funksiyasining freymi buni bitta o'tishda hisoblaydi. Muhimi freym turi: oynaga yechishlar soni emas, vaqt oralig'i kiradi, shuning uchun RANGE. ts butun son, demak oraliq ts - 86399 dan ts gacha.

Yechim

SELECT id, atm_id, ts, last24
FROM (
  SELECT id, atm_id, ts,
         SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY atm_id ORDER BY ts
                           RANGE BETWEEN 86399 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last24
  FROM withdrawals
) t
WHERE last24 > 150000000

Oyna funksiyasini WHERE da ishlatib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun jami ichki so'rovda hisoblanadi va tashqarida filtrlanadi. Namunada 5-yechish aynan 24 soat keyin bo'lgan: 1-yechish uning oynasidan chiqadi va jami 120 million, signal yo'q.

Tuzoqlar

86400 PRECEDING aynan 24 soat oldingi yechishni ham oladi. Shartda u oynaga kirmaydi, chunki "ts - 86400 dan katta".

Ichki so'rov yoki o'zi bilan JOIN to'g'ri natija beradi, lekin sekin. atm_id indeksi faqat bankomatni ajratadi, bitta bankomatda esa ikki yarim ming yechish bor va har biri uchun ularning hammasi ko'rib chiqiladi:

SELECT id, atm_id, ts, last24
FROM (
  SELECT w.id, w.atm_id, w.ts,
         (SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM withdrawals p
          WHERE p.atm_id = w.atm_id AND p.ts > w.ts - 86400 AND p.ts <= w.ts) AS last24
  FROM withdrawals w
) t
WHERE last24 > 150000000

Freymsiz SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY atm_id ORDER BY ts) bankomat ishlay boshlagandan beri jamini beradi va ertasi kuni ham signal o'chmaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, atm_id, ts, last24
FROM (
  SELECT id, atm_id, ts,
         SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY atm_id ORDER BY ts) AS last24
  FROM withdrawals
) t
WHERE last24 > 150000000

ROWS freymi esa yechishlarni sanaydi va kunlik tanaffusni bilmaydi.
